places.name: Valentines Park
places.description: A large Victorian park surrounding the historic Valentines Mansion.

places.name: Hainault Forest Country Park
places.description: A surviving fragment of the ancient Forest of Essex, with woodland, a lake, and a small farm park.

history.summary: IG5 lies within Redbridge. Formed in 1965 from Ilford, Wanstead, and Woodford, formerly part of Essex. Hainault Forest and Valentines Park are among its larger green spaces.
